newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P keeps Sumitomo Corp under negative review.
newsitem.headline: S&P keeps Sumitomo Corp under negative review.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday that it had kept the A1 short-term ratings of Sumitomo Corp and its subsidiaries under review with negative implications.

Sumitomo Corp and its subsidiaries remained under review with negative implications following the company's announcement that losses from unauthorised trading in its non-ferrous metals division have risen to $2.6 billion from a previously estimated $1.8 billion, S&P said in a statement.

Although Sumitomo's announcement significantly reduced the uncertainty surrounding the problems it faces related to the large-scale unauthorised copper trading, its rating remains under negative review pending a review of the impact on the company's financial position, S&P said.

After the review is done, the company's rating may be affirmed at A1, based on Sumitomo's financial capacity to absorb the $2.6 billion loss, strong operating performance so far this year, and little apparent impact on the company's business, S&P said.
